SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, s.section_name AS sectionName, s.direction AS direction, AVG(sd.duration_seconds) AS avgDurationSeconds, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM section_driving sd INNER JOIN section s ON sd.section_id = s.section_id
AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) >= 7 AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) < 9
AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) >= 17 AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) < 19
GROUP BY s.section_id, s.section_name, s.direction ORDER BY avgDurationSeconds DESC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, s.path AS path FROM section s JOIN route r ON r.route_id = #{routeId} WHERE s.route_number = CONCAT( SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.route_name, '路', 1), '_', CASE r.is_up_or_down WHEN '上行' THEN 'up' WHEN '下行' THEN 'down' ELSE r.is_up_or_down END ) ORDER BY s.section_id

SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, s.section_name AS sectionName, s.path AS path, COALESCE(sds.avg_duration_seconds, 0) AS avgDuration FROM section s JOIN route r ON r.route_id = #{routeId} LEFT JOIN section_driving_summary sds ON sds.section_id = s.section_id WHERE s.route_number = CONCAT( SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.route_name, '路', 1), '_', CASE r.is_up_or_down WHEN '上行' THEN 'up' WHEN '下行' THEN 'down' ELSE r.is_up_or_down END ) ORDER BY s.section_id
